items.headline: 316-unit apartment plan at 400 Saratoga Avenue golf course on Planning Commission agenda
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a recommendation to amend the General Plan and rezone 400 Saratoga Avenue for a five-story, 316-unit apartment building. The proposal would also reconfigure the existing nine-hole golf course and dedicate land for a public park. An environmental impact report was prepared and circulated for public review.

items.headline: Gymnastics facility proposed in Corvin Drive warehouse
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a conditional use permit for a gymnastics facility that would occupy 7,116 square feet of the existing 16,576-square-foot warehouse at 3051 Corvin Drive.

items.headline: Neighbor appeal of Rita Court home addition on agenda
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed an appeal of a staff-level approval for a 517-square-foot first-floor and 1,000-square-foot second-floor addition to a single-story home at 2261 Rita Court, on a 6,272-square-foot lot.

items.headline: 14 townhomes and a duplex with commercial space proposed near Civic Center Drive
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a vesting tentative subdivision map for condominium purposes covering 14 townhomes and a duplex building with commercial space at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street. The agenda cited a CEQA exemption under AB 130 (2025).

items.headline: Deferral of 590-unit El Camino Real project on council agenda
items.summary: The joint City Council and Stadium Authority agenda for November 17 listed an action to defer consideration of a vesting tentative map and development agreement for a mixed-use project at 2610 El Camino Real. The project calls for 590 homes and 15,000 square feet of commercial space and is subject to SB 330 (2019).

items.headline: Council special meeting on Convention Center finances
items.summary: The agenda for the November 17 special City Council meeting at 5:30 PM listed a review of Santa Clara Convention Center financial status reports for the fourth quarter of FY 2024/25 and all four quarters of FY 2025/26.

items.headline: Campbell agenda: rezoning 480 Chapman from commercial to single-family
items.summary: The November 10 Planning Commission agenda listed a public hearing on an application from GKW Architects on behalf of owners Joseph and Alicia Lam to change 480 Chapman from Neighborhood Commercial to Low Density Residential and R-1-10 single-family zoning. The lot already has a single-family house, and the change would end its legal nonconforming status. Staff recommended that the commission forward the request to the City Council. The tentative City Council date was December 1, 2026.

items.headline: Planning Commission agenda: 251-unit Eden Housing project on N. Wolfe Road
items.summary: The November 10 Planning Commission agenda listed Architectural and Site Approval and Tree Removal Permits for Eden Housing's proposed 251-unit residential development at 10333 N. Wolfe Road. The application also covers site and trail improvements and the removal and replacement of 117 protected trees.
